name: Sprue
author: E. T. Carter
description: A night foundry hall: a crane ladle hangs from a gantry on the left third and pours a violet-white stream into a basin, the metal crawls with crust down a winding sand runner past iron-framed moulds while a furnace mouth feeds a far channel. Sparks rise and cool from the pour, heat glow climbs the brick walls and cold blue shafts slant through the smoke from high arched windows.

params.label: Flow
params.effect: How fast the crusted metal runs down the channels and the stream falls.

params.label: Sparks
params.effect: How many sparks rise from the pour and the furnace, and how bright.

params.label: Heat
params.effect: Brightness of the molten metal and the glow it throws on walls, moulds and chains.

params.label: Window shafts
params.effect: Strength of the cold light slanting through the smoke from the high windows.
